question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'endangered'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence* 'The main causes of an animal becoming (5)_________ are poaching and smuggling.' *requires an appropriate word from the given options to fill in the **blank number 5.**
 
• The marked option **'endangered'** means in danger of disappearing from the world (becoming extinct). (जिनका अस्तित्‍व ख़तरे में है; संकटग्रस्‍त).
 
 
• **Example: ***Snow leopard is one of the **endangered **species of Asia.*
 
 
 
• From the given options, only** 'endangered' **describes the context of the given sentence and is best fit for the **blank number 5.**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

Correct Paragraph:__ *Deforestation, wildfires and pollution cause animals (1) __to__ lose their homes. Animals may be (2) __affected__* *by their surroundings. Most individuals are (3) __unaware__ that they are taking down an animal's home when they cut down trees for wood. Animal (4) __habitat__ is also lost as a result of wildfires. The main causes of an animal becoming **(5)** __**endangered**__* *are poaching and smuggling. Pollution is extremely harmful to animals and their environments. Animals are interested and try to eat the pollution-causing things. Furthermore, some rivers and natural resources are becoming polluted, forcing animals to relocate.*
